Container.Name: Orca
Container.Overview: Runs Orca (onorca.dev) headless with orca serve, so its coding agents, worktrees and terminals live on your server. Pair the Orca desktop app, the browser client or the Orca phone app to it. The pairing link is printed in this container's log. Repositories live in a Projects folder you choose, and GitHub repositories can be cloned into it from a list. Agent CLIs install from npm on first start, and the terminals can use bash, zsh (with optional Oh My Zsh) or fish. Optional: map the Docker or libvirt socket so agents can run their own containers or VMs; either one gives the agents root-level control of this server.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: orca agents claude codex worktrees ai coding

Config.Name: Orca port
Config.Description: Port the Orca clients connect to.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Orca's state, pairing keys, agent logins, shell settings and worktrees.

Config.Name: Projects
Config.Description: Your repositories, at /projects in the container. Open or clone projects here from Orca. Point it at any share.

Config.Name: Pairing address
Config.Description: Address the clients dial: this server's LAN IP, Tailscale IP or hostname. Leave empty when Use Tailscale is on and the container's own Tailscale IP is used.

Config.Name: GitHub token
Config.Description: Optional. A GitHub token git and gh use for cloning, pushing and pull requests.

Config.Name: Repositories
Config.Description: Optional. Space-separated owner/name (GitHub) or clone URLs. Each is cloned once into /projects and added to Orca.

Config.Name: Agents
Config.Description: Space-separated agent CLIs installed once into the Data folder: amp, auggie, autohand, claude, cline, codebuddy, codebuff, codex, command-code, continue, copilot, crush, droid, freebuff, gemini, kilo, kimi, minimax, omp, openclaw, opencode, pi, qwen, or any npm package name. Log in to each agent once from the container console.

Config.Name: Shell
Config.Description: Shell for Orca's terminals and the console. tmux is installed as well.

Config.Name: Oh My Zsh
Config.Description: Install Oh My Zsh into the Data folder on the next start. Used when Shell is zsh.

Config.Name: Git user name
Config.Description: Optional. Name on the agents' commits.

Config.Name: Git user email
Config.Description: Optional. Email on the agents' commits.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Optional. Enter /var/run/docker.sock to let agents create and manage containers, for example a sandbox per agent. This gives the agents root-level control of this server.

Config.Name: libvirt socket
Config.Description: Optional. Enter /var/run/libvirt/libvirt-sock to let agents start and manage VMs with virsh. This gives the agents root-level control of this server.

Config.Name: Extra serve arguments
Config.Description: Optional flags for orca serve, for example --mobile-pairing to print a phone pairing link.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the agents run as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the agents run as.
